srcs: When tissue is injured, the body’s immune system sends white blood cells to the area.

There is no cure for chronic inflammation, but it can be managed with medication, lifestyle changes, and physical therapy.

srcs: Science is a systematic enterprise that builds and organizes knowledge in the form of testable explanations and predictions about the natural world.
